group.title: A business trip schedule
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Hotel confirmation
Guest: Dana Lin. Check-in: October 3. Check-out: October 5 by 11 a.m. Two nights, breakfast included. Luggage storage after checkout is complimentary. A late checkout until 1 p.m. costs NT$800 and must be requested in advance.

DOCUMENT 2 — Client meeting schedule, October 5
12:30 p.m.: Working lunch at Green Table, opposite the hotel.
1:30–3:00 p.m.: Product planning meeting at the client’s office, a ten-minute walk from the restaurant.
Please bring the printed sample labels. No projector is needed.

DOCUMENT 3 — Dana’s message to a colleague
My train leaves at 5 p.m., and I want to avoid extra hotel charges. I will check out before the standard deadline and leave my suitcase at the hotel. After the meeting, I’ll collect it and take a taxi to the station. I have already packed the labels.
group.passageZh:
文件一——飯店訂房確認
住客：Dana Lin。十月三日入住，十月五日最遲於上午十一點退房。共兩晚，含早餐。退房後免費寄放行李。延遲至下午一點退房需加收新臺幣八百元，且須事先申請。

文件二——十月五日客戶會議時程
12:30：在飯店對面的 Green Table 進行工作午餐。
13:30–15:00：客戶辦公室產品規劃會議，從餐廳步行十分鐘可達。
請帶印好的樣品標籤，不需要投影機。

文件三——Dana 給同事的訊息
我的火車下午五點發車，我想避免額外飯店費用。我會在一般期限前退房，把行李箱留在飯店。會議後再取行李，搭計程車到車站。我已把標籤收進行李裡了。
